rulings: Ruling: Trace actual original draw calls in a controlled observer arm and compare an unloaded OFFcontrol — direct boundary evidence is needed after CPU-only models remainyellow — if wrong, readback timing may change the phenomenon and observation cannot qualify as neutral.

Ruling: Resolve only one matched-format framebuffer pixel and retain MSAAsample association uncertainty — fulltexture extraction previously interfered with native capture — if wrong, resolveddepth cannot establish exact varying coordinates and another discriminating measurement is needed.

Ruling: Keep original3/4 history separate from any modified-renderer candidate matrix — a repair may intentionally change renderer behavior — if wrong, a candidate4/4 result still cannot attest the unmodified original pipeline.

Ruling: Record immutable draw SceneSetup matrices and keep CPU capture labels conditional; terminal sync only after all original source copies, before callback removal — pinned MetaDrive uses Cull threading, so mutable camera parent is not a reliable GPU pose test — if wrong, a late scene could be observed or synchronization could affect timing, and source-pixel identity must reject unsupported association.

Ruling: Qualify the observed multisample-storage resolve path with its measured effective count, never the requested count — firstactual softpipe reports samples1 despite framebuffer-request4 and uses successful resolve; query sample_buffers/max_samples to disambiguate and report multiple-sample qualification false unless observed>1 — if wrong, a fullscene framebuffer with a greater actual sample count remains unqualified, so owner proof must not exceed canary scope.

Ruling: Use a single target depth clear before the original terrain draw, preserving GL_LESS, to expose its nearest fragment — measured trace shows terrain leaves a geometry-owned gray pixel unchanged; GL_ALWAYS would also alter terrain self-depth order — if wrong, clearing depth is an intentional source intervention and cannot qualify as a repair or prove the original candidate fragment alone.

Ruling: Add bounded1024byte GPUterrain view-row reads and missing active projection/model-view/terrain uniforms — actual shader uses procedural chunk/LOD data and separate geometry matrices absent from firsttrace — if wrong, readback timing may perturb culling/LOD, so all measurements remain interventions and final model cohort must be uninstrumented.

Ruling: Give RGBterrain a fixed earlier bin while preserving LESS, rather than changing depth arithmetic or within-terrain tie tests — the actual one-pixel contrast proves an exact quantized depth tie, and the earlier ground wins independent of opaque order — if wrong, quantized coincident surfaces will prefer terrain intentionally; this is a separate modified candidate and must pass full-image repeats and the fresh strict model cohort.

Ruling: Prepare the independent official-cohort adapters while actual renderer validation runs, but do not execute models until that gate qualifies — the candidate API/source is frozen and this avoids idle waiting — if wrong, the prepared orchestration needs updating or stays unused; no model result may bypass repair qualification.

Ruling: Begin the single fresh wholebranch code review while the frozen final implementation's official cohort runs, but hold the review's final acceptance until its actual receipts arrive — implementation/sourceCI/renderer qualification are complete and this removes idle serialized review time — if wrong, a model failure requires the same reviewer context to inspect the resulting code delta before its first final verdict; no actual or final gate may be bypassed and no second review seat is added.

Ruling: Reject scissor-clipped private resolves using already captured state and preserve successful GL operations, then independently revalidate the unchanged authenticated actual receipts — actual03/04 allinclude destination0,0 and candidate/model producers remain byte-identical, so no changed successful renderer/model behavior needs rerunning — if wrong, newly supported scissor/GPU paths remain unqualified and the revised helper must not be described as remotely exercised.
